units.source_text: 大致是些傻乎乎的漫画。
要说什么地方好笑，他可是回答不出来的，只是些毫无意义的，粗糙的涂鸦而已。

en.t: If asked what was funny about them, he could not have answered; they were nothing more than meaningless, crude doodles.

units.source_text: 大个子男人骑上马，马腿都给压断了，瘫在地上，马脸上的表情令人忍俊不禁。

en.t: A big man got on a horse, the horse's legs were crushed under him, and as it lay collapsed on the ground, the expression on its face was irresistibly funny.

units.source_text: 自己这副样子，真还亏笑得出来。

en.t: In his own state, it was a wonder he could still laugh.
If he still knew shame, there was some hope.
There was, after all, a limit to accepting things as they were.

units.source_text: 归根结底那只是手段，不应该是目的。

en.t: In the end, that was only a means, and should not become the goal.

units.source_text: 冬眠什么的，能听见还可以，但愿不会变成鼹鼠，一生一世不想见阳光。

en.t: Hibernation and the like were all right to hear about, but he hoped he would not turn into a mole and spend his whole life wanting never to see the sunlight.
